definitions.explanation: A very short period of time. Emphasizes the transience or brevity of an experience, often with a poignant or wistful nuance.

examples.japanese: {束|つか}の{間|ま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{休息|きゅうそく}→休息：02587_kyuusoku⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a brief moment of rest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|や}んで→止む：01153_yamu⟧、{束|つか}の{間|ま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{晴|は}れ{間|ま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The rain stopped, and a brief clearing spread across the sky.

examples.japanese: {束|つか}の{間|ま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|しあわ}せだった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: It was a fleeting happiness, but I can never forget that time.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically used as a noun modifier with the ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ particle: {束|つか}の{間|ま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. Carries a literary, slightly melancholy tone — the happiness or peace described is precious precisely because it is so short. Common in written prose and narration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {束|つか}の{間|ま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧: a fleeting peace
- {束|つか}の{間|ま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|しあわ}せ: fleeting happiness
- {束|つか}の{間|ま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{休息|きゅうそく}→休息：02587_kyuusoku⟧: a brief rest

ETYMOLOGY:
{束|つか} originally referred to the width of a clenched fist (about 7-8 cm), used as a unit of measurement. {束|つか}の{間|ま} literally means "the space of a fist" — metaphorically, an extremely short time.

cross_references.label: a moment, a while, a brief time
